paragraphs: Tagline: Every Sign. Every Voice. Mission: An AI-powered accessibility platform designed to bridge deaf and hard-of-hearing communication with hearing participants using Indian Sign Language (ISL), computer vision, text, and speech. Built for a 24-hour hackathon.
features: Live Hand Tracking: Real-time browser MediaPipe Tasks Vision hand landmarker extracting 21 3D coordinates per hand.
Scale & Translation Invariance: Wrist-centered relative coordinate normalization into a standardized 126-dimensional feature vector.
Trained Machine Learning Model: Real scikit-learn Random Forest classifier with 100 decision trees, serialized using joblib.

Honest Confidence Filtering: Only displays confident predictions above user-configured thresholds (default 70%), with cooldown smoothing. If confidence is insufficient, displays "Sign not recognized clearly. Please try…
Custom Model Training Studio: Record real webcam hand gesture samples for any custom sign label, manage sample counts, and train models with live cross-validation metrics.
